recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future work should not reopen FHIR-45455 solely to add redundant examples; if the work group wants examples for every less-common FHIRPath helper, that should be handled as a separate editorial tracker because the slice parameter ambiguity approved in FHIR-45455 is already resolved.
issue_request: FHIR-45455 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I change request for the FHIRPath Additional functions section, asking for function bookmarks, clearer slice(structure, name) parameter definitions, and examples for FHIR-specific functions. The approved slice text defined structure as the possibly versioned canonical for the profile containing the slice and name as either a unique ElementDefinition.sliceName or the ElementDefinition.id when the sliceName is not unique.
initial_application: Current source history includes explicit FHIR-45455 application commits: bbae11ecde added function-level anchors in source/fhirpath.html, 8926ed3049 added examples to the FHIRPath function section, and f3149e9502 replaced the slice prose with the current structure/name parameter explanation, %profile guidance, and Patient.telecom slice example while also incorporating related FHIR-42983 clarification.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread shows the concrete ambiguity was how slice(structure, name) identifies a slice when sliceName values are not globally unique in a StructureDefinition, and it requested examples plus function bookmarks. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-05-06 record the persuasive 11-0-0 vote. Related Applied issue FHIR-42983 and a later 2025 infrastructure Zulip discussion refined the same slice definition, supporting the current wording rather than a literal duplicate of the Jira prose.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/fhirpath.html already has anchors for Additional functions, defines slice(structure : string, name : string), explains both structure and name arguments including ElementDefinition.sliceName versus ElementDefinition.id, documents %profile, and includes a concrete Patient.telecom slice example.
